c.v: Scarlet Homes was founded by directors Bharat and Pradip with one goal: to make personalised, luxury homes accessible and to make the building journey simple, transparent and rewarding.
Like any new builder, we had to earn trust in a competitive market and refine the right inclusions and building solutions. Persistence, innovation and integrity got us there.
Today our biggest strength is our people. We listen closely, embrace your ideas and pay attention to every detail, so each home reflects the family who lives in it.
Four principles behind every Scarlet home.
Every home reflects the personality, preferences and lifestyle of the family who lives in it.
Clear fixed-price contracts, full inclusions and honest advice at every stage.
We earn trust by doing what we say, on every build, every time.
Building with care, precision and pride for homes that last.
You deal with the people who own the business. Bharat and Pradip are involved in every build, and you get their direct number, not a call centre.
Involved from your first consultation to the day we hand over your keys.
Hands-on across design, approvals and construction on every Scarlet home.

c.v: We started as a premium builder offering full turnkey homes, ready to move in and enjoy, and that is still our primary service.

As the market changed, we added our Freedom and Standard series for clients who want to take charge of some finishing details themselves. Whichever series you choose, you get the same fixed-price, director-led build.
